scope: Navigation icon mapping only. No content, installed instance, game launch, or pack metadata changes.

engine.evidence: Selected Frontmatter.parse reads navigation.icon as a string and resolves it through IdUtils.resolveId. FrontmatterNavigation stores iconItemId. NavigationUtil.createNavigationIcon looks up BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getHolder and creates an ItemStack. Mod namespaces are supported without a separate decorative-icon registry.

verification_boundary: Original selected-binary registration evidence preserved for unchanged icons. All nine selected mod artifacts were rehashed against current pack metadata. Farmers Delight ModItems class bytes are unchanged from the prior audited artifact. Twenty added topic icons were verified through Minecraft 1.21.1 server Items registration bytecode or selected Hybrid Aquatic and Oceans Delight registration chains. Generator --check-navigation and scripts/handbook_navigation.py were read-only sources for all 131 topic mappings and both locale labels. The checksum-selected GuideME 21.1.19 NavigationTree metadata-only probe passed for both locales with eighteen roots, all sibling orders, semantic reorder negative controls and retired-page resurrection and repair controls. All 722 main source resource files remain byte-identical to the approved guide worktree. Static registration and byte parity do not establish live registry resolution or rendered client behavior.

registration_class_continuity.evidence_policy: Original registration evidence retained because the selected registration class bytes have not changed.

provenance.registration_scope: HybridAquaticForge static initializer loads HAItems unconditionally. HAItems.register delegates to CommonClass.ITEMS.register. registerSpawnEgg delegates through ForgePlatformHelper.registerSpawnEggItem to the same item provider. ForgeRegistrationFactory.create binds DeferredRegister to the mod event bus, and Provider.register calls DeferredRegister.register. These four item entries are unconditional static registrations, not inferred from models.
